summary: perf(settings): lazy-load scoped-keys in the OAuth finish hook
description:
Because:

- The mount prefetch of the scoped-keys chunk also ran for Sync flows without keysJwk, which never build a keys JWE.

This commit:

- Gates the prefetch in useFinishOAuthFlowHandler on keysJwk only.
- Adds a test that a Sync integration without keysJwk does not prefetch the chunk.

Closes FXA-14854
